title: Surge Visor: compact ops dashboard and burst-tuning controls for Dedicated capacity
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Design a compact, task-focused operations panel (Surge Visor) for Dedicated GPU pools that blends real-time health signals, predictive surge suggestions, and one-click burst tuning. The goal is to give SREs and platform owners a single, low-visual-noise surface for (1) triaging pool health, (2) applying temporary burst configurations, and (3) previewing cost/latency impact before committing. This ticket covers wireframes → interactive prototype → PM/Eng review and handoff.
acceptance_criteria: Hi-fi Figma prototype for desktop and tablet with interactive burst slider and confirmation modal
Clear mapping of health signals (utilization, queue latency, GPU memory pressure, error rate) to visual states and suggested actions
Microcopy for burst modes: 'speculative', 'guaranteed', 'emergency' + rollback guidance
Lightweight cost preview showing estimated incremental hourly cost and latency delta for chosen burst parameters
Design tokens and component specs documented for Frontend handoff (CSS vars, spacing, states)
PM and Eng sign-off recorded in ticket comments and linked PRD
comments: 2025-02-12 — Aisha Patel: Kickoff: initial problem framing with Platform SREs. Key constraints: must work inside Console's compact flyout, support keyboard-first operations, and not duplicate full Cluster Health dashboard.

2025-03-02 — Aisha Patel: Updated acceptance criteria after design critique. Marking Security review required. Will iterate prototype with suggested copy changes and add keyboard flows.
decisions: Chosen layout: Hybrid compact card — left column shows condensed health timeline and top metrics, right column contains burst controls and cost preview. This balances triage and action within limited vertical space.

Burst presets: three named modes (speculative, guaranteed, emergency) to communicate trade-offs between cost and latency. Each preset maps to GPU reservation minutes, burst parallelism, and preemption policy.
Preview behavior: preview API returns estimated cost and worst-case latency delta for 15/30/60 minute durations. Preview calls are logged as read-only events per Security guidance.
Rollback UX: after a burst is applied, show a 5-minute 'quick-revert' toast that can undo the change without navigating away. Full rollback lives in the Pool History view.
Accessibility: controls will be operable by keyboard with ARIA labels; color choices will meet AA contrast on important states.
